About Me

I'm a motivated and creative Frontend Developer from Nagpur, Maharashtra with hands-on experience building responsive, interactive web applications and AI-powered tools from scratch.

My journey spans web development, cybersecurity, data analytics, and AI — all certified through industry programs from Deloitte, TCS iON, HP LIFE, and Simplilearn. I don't just learn — I build things that look great and work flawlessly.

Currently completing my HSC Science (2026) and actively seeking opportunities to collaborate on real-world projects, solve actual problems, and grow as a developer.

02 ——

Built from scratch, on purpose.

I taught myself HTML, CSS and JavaScript, then kept going: React, Three.js, and the APIs behind modern AI products. I like interfaces that feel alive, with custom CSS animation instead of template kits.

My AI work is practical. Zara, my voice companion, talks through Groq and ElevenLabs behind a serverless proxy that keeps API keys off the browser. I also deliver for real clients, like a coaching institute in Nagpur.
